authority: reconcile_stripe_subscription (SECURITY DEFINER, fixed search_path=public, service_role execute only) + provider_event_receipts (append-only, RLS on, browser revoked)

event_type_matrix.customer.subscription.created: reduced -> one typed command -> exactly one RPC call
event_type_matrix.customer.subscription.updated: reduced -> one typed command -> exactly one RPC call
event_type_matrix.customer.subscription.deleted: reduced -> plan_revoke (status canceled) -> exactly one RPC call
event_type_matrix.checkout.session.completed: subscription retrieved -> reduced -> exactly one RPC call
event_type_matrix.other: bounded correction, zero RPC calls, zero profile mutations

status_matrix.other: unsupported_status correction, zero RPC calls, zero profile mutations

price_matrix.unknown_or_absent: unknown_price correction; never free; zero RPC calls

ordering_rule: events compare as the tuple (provider_created_epoch, provider_event_id); equal-time same-value replay and equal-time contradiction both fail closed with zero profile mutations
write_invariant: one provider_event_receipts INSERT + at most one profiles UPDATE inside the same RPC transaction; receipts are append-only (guard trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE); a failed profile transition raises and rolls back the receipt with it
manual_precedence: profile subscription_status in (manual_enterprise, complimentary) is preserved; receipt recorded applied=false with outcome_code=manual_precedence; profile never overwritten by the Stripe claim
